oneStopSecurity.note: ADR transit page: re-screening is skipped after flights from the US, Canada, Montenegro, the Faroe Islands (Vagar), Greenland (Kangerlussuaq), Guernsey, Jersey and the Isle of Man. The last four were removed from the EU list by Reg. 2025/920 and are left out here. ADR does not list the United Kingdom, so UK arrivals are treated as re-screened at FCO (conservative; conflict with the EU list). The ADR page still lists the four airports removed in May 2025, so it predates Reg. 2025/920 (stale): owner capture of a current ADR page (DR-B5, FCO side).

specialScreening.text: ADR: traditional X-ray screening (liquids ≤ 100 ml, taken out with electronics) stays in force for direct flights to the USA or Israel of airlines that check in at Terminal 1 (ITA Airways: feed TLV departures report terminal 1), i.e. a separate screening flow; ITA passengers to the USA / Israel must check in at the airport counters. Boarding in area E. No time is published ("arrive well in advance").

Flights to Israel: whether this airline has an additional document check, interview or separate screening at Rome Fiumicino (ADR documents a separate flow for US and Israel flights only for airlines checking in at T1) is not established by any source we could read. Allow extra time and check with the airline.

US-bound flights: TSA / DHS enhanced security measures for all last-point-of-departure airports (2017, still the baseline as far as known) may add checks at check-in or at the gate (interviews, document checks, separate screening of electronics). The procedures are not public; no time is known.

lines.eligibility: Departing passengers already past T3 passport control (non-Schengen airside) with a gate at E31–E44; the only passenger link to those gates. They board the central platform at T3 (quota 12.10) and alight on a side platform at the satellite (quota 6.50), physically separated from the arrivals boarding platform (ADR 2024).
lines.notes: APMS ("SkyBridge"): 4 rubber-tyred vehicles coupled in pairs = 2 shuttles, each on its own guideway, fully automatic, run by Alstom from a control room at satellite quota 6.50; double or single shuttle by traffic, one shuttle on call from about midnight to 05:30 (ADR operating instruction 2024-06-04). Each shuttle shuttles back and forth: it carries departing passengers westbound and arriving passengers eastbound; the station platforms keep the two flows apart (central platform = boarding, side platforms = alighting). Ride ≈ 1 min (observed in two uncut ride clips). Not operated while E31–E44 was closed (2020-11-17 to at most 2022-04-08), modelled on the satellite areas. Replacement: ADR tendered a "new People Mover system" in 2023 (TED 336457-2023) and an apron shuttle-bus service "during the People Mover replacement works" (EU notice, 403, dates unknown): a future suspension is expected but cannot be dated (q:fco-new-people-mover). Unplanned outages > 15/30 min: contingency buses (l:fco-apms-outage-bus, not routed).

ride.note: motion ≈ 50–60 s in two ride clips with 1-s frames and no cut (2015, 2016; one misses the start, the other the stop) plus the door cycle; guideway ≈ 0.6 km (OSM)

rules.text: Terminal 1 / gates A = domestic and Schengen flights; Terminal 3 / gates E = non-Schengen (extra-Schengen and intercontinental). All E gates lie beyond the T3 passport control.
Any move between the A gates (Schengen) and the E gates (non-Schengen) crosses a passport control: exit control at T3 before the E plaza (A→E), entry control in the galleria transiti (E→A).

Gates E31–E44 are reachable only by the SkyBridge people mover (APMS, run by Alstom: 2 two-car shuttles on 2 independent guideways). Departing passengers board the central platform at T3 (quota 12.10, one level above the E plaza) and alight at the satellite (quota 6.50) below its departures level (11.50); arriving passengers board the satellite central platform from the arrivals ring and alight on the T3 side platforms; the platforms keep the two flows apart. From about midnight to 05:30 one shuttle runs on call. A departing passenger cannot go back without clearing security again. Allow extra time (guide: +15 min).
EU Entry/Exit System in force since 2025-10-12: biometric registration at passport control lengthens non-Schengen processing times.
Published minimum connecting time 40 min (guide figure); realistic allowances from the same guide: Schengen→Schengen T1 45–60 min, any Schengen↔non-Schengen 75–90 min.

Non-Schengen arrivals are separated from departures beyond the aircraft door: E31–E44 arrivals use the satellite level-1 ring and the eastbound SkyBridge; the E piers lead to "Uscita/Exit" and down to the T3 arrivals passport control, reclaim and customs, or to the transit desks. Schengen arrivals in T1 share the departure piers and leave by the "Uscita" escalators to the T1 reclaim.

The renewed Terminal 3 was inaugurated on 2025-05-13 (works over four years with the terminal open): 248 check-in counters, renewed security for sensitive flights, baggage belts 9 → 14, upgraded transit areas. The current ADR T3 ground-level map shows belts 1–14.

If the people mover stops for more than 15 min (external cause) or 30 min (system fault), ADR runs apron buses: departing E31–44 passengers are re-screened at T3 and boarded at gate E1; arriving passengers are bussed from a collection point under emergency exit E31-E44 to T3 Arrivals; airlines may serve E31–44 stands as remote stands (ADR operating instruction 2024-06-04).

Rail (phase 3, read 2026-11-01). The Leonardo Express runs non-stop between Fiumicino Aeroporto and Roma Termini in 32 min, every 15 min: from Fiumicino Aeroporto 05:38–23:27, from Roma Termini 04:50–23:05. The Trenitalia and ADR train pages give identical figures. FL1 regional trains (to Roma Tiburtina and beyond) run every 15 min on working days and every 30 min at weekends and holidays (ADR). The FL1 first and last trains were not extracted: the text layer of the Trenitalia Lazio timetable (valid from 2026-10-24) is unreadable. The station is a landside node, reached by the elevated walkways from T1 and T3. The station walks have no hours because the FL1 hours are not established, so at 03:00 a route to the station is shown although no train runs.

openQuestions.question: Do gates A4–A10 and A53–A59 exist in 2025–2026? The ADR map page lists A1-3 and A31-52, but the ADR overview map (2024-05), OSM area names and 2024 signs say A1-10 and A31-59.
openQuestions.impact: Gate search / placement only; routing unchanged (same piers).
openQuestions.howToResolve: Owner photo of the T1 gate directory signs, or current FCO departures boards keyed by gate.

openQuestions.question: SkyBridge headway and exact ride time. ADR (2024) gives the pattern (one or two shuttles by traffic, run according to the flights planned at E31–44; one shuttle on call from about midnight to 05:30) but no headway or timetable; the ride (≈ 1 min) comes from video clips that miss the door cycle.
openQuestions.impact: Wait and ride on every E31–44 route (now derived/observed, ± 2 min).
openQuestions.howToResolve: Owner capture: an uncut video or stopwatch from the T3 platform (doors closing) to the satellite (doors opening), plus the wait at the platform at a busy and a quiet hour.

openQuestions.question: Can a departing passenger already in the E plaza walk back to the A gates (signed 'Gates A1-83'), and is the passport control on that path the galleria transiti control drawn at A21-27?
openQuestions.impact: E→A routes for passengers who are not arriving transfers.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Video or field walk following the 'A1-83' sign from the E plaza.

openQuestions.question: Where and for whom is transfer security applied for non-Schengen → non-Schengen and non-Schengen → Schengen connections (one-stop-security origins vs others)?
openQuestions.impact: Control allowance on transfers into E1-8 and A.
openQuestions.howToResolve: ADR transit page (owner capture), ITA Airways connection guide, a transit video from a non-EU origin.

openQuestions.question: Does the airside space after T3 security connect to the T1 corridor before passport control (i.e. can a Schengen passenger screened at T3 walk to the A gates)?
openQuestions.impact: T3 landside → A gates route (otherwise via T1 landside and T1 security).
openQuestions.howToResolve: Walk-through video starting at T3 security heading to 'A1-83'.

openQuestions.question: Are any A gates (e.g. A21–A27 next to the galleria passport control) operated as non-Schengen or swing gates?
openQuestions.impact: Zone of A21–A27 and possible non-Schengen departures from T1.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Flight boards keyed by gate (non-Schengen flights from A gates), ADR statement.

openQuestions.question: Confirm that the ground-level gate rooms (A21–27, A34–41, A51–52, A74–83, E1–8, E53–61) board by apron bus.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Trip reports/videos boarding at these gates.

openQuestions.question: Terminal 5 status (closed 2017 for renovation, used for events since) — any passenger use in 2026?
openQuestions.impact: None currently; would add a landside/airside area if reopened.

openQuestions.question: When will the existing SkyBridge be replaced? ADR tendered a "new People Mover system" in 2023: TED 336457-2023, read in phase 3 on ted.europa.eu. It was an open procedure, published 2023-06-06, with tenders due 2023-07-28 and an estimated value of EUR 86 M, covering design, supply, and operation and maintenance. The contract runs 264 months, including a 120-month renewal. The notice gives no works dates, and no award notice was found. ADR also tendered an apron shuttle-bus service "during the People Mover replacement works" (EU notice, HTTP 403). Meanwhile Alstom runs the existing APMS under framework contract CQ20230147, concluded 2023-11-01 (TED 006352-2024, EUR 5 M). The replacement implies a period in which buses serve E31–44, with unknown dates.
openQuestions.impact: A future suspension of both SkyBridge lines and a dated replacement bus line (`replaces`), possibly with longer E31–44 times.
openQuestions.howToResolve: An ADR announcement of the works or an award notice for TED 336457-2023 (search ted.europa.eu for CIG 9857928B86). Owner capture of the op.europa.eu shuttle notice (dates, duration, bus stops).

openQuestions.question: Since the T3 renewal (2025), do arriving passengers at E11-24 and E51-61 still walk through the departure lounges (as filmed in Dec 2022) or use a separate arrivals corridor?
openQuestions.impact: Arrivals-flow minutes and whether an arriving passenger can enter the E departure plaza without transfer screening.
openQuestions.howToResolve: A 2025–2026 arrival video at an E11-24 or E51-61 contact gate.

openQuestions.question: What became of "ex boarding area C" (to open before summer 2023) and "ex Pier D" (renovation from 2023) named in the April 2023 ADR release, and do they correspond to A1-3/A1-10 or to A53-A59?
openQuestions.impact: Gate lists and status of the A1-3 area; possible new gates in T1.
openQuestions.howToResolve: ADR press releases 2023–2026 (theflightclub.it is blocked, 403), owner photo of the T1 gate directory.

openQuestions.question: Signs in the E plaza filmed in 2024 read "E5-63" and "E11-63", while the ADR maps (2024-12) list E51–E61 only: do gates E62–E63 exist (remote or bus gates)?
openQuestions.impact: Gate lookup for E62/E63 (currently unknown); no effect on area routing (they would belong to the E51-61 area).
openQuestions.howToResolve: Owner photo of the E plaza signs or the E51-61 ground-level room; ADR gate list.

openQuestions.question: Does FCO display walking times to gates (a 2026 guide says the "Voli in coincidenza" connection boards show walking times; no example found)?
openQuestions.impact: Would turn the derived/measured walking minutes into published values.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Owner photo of a connection board or a gate-directory sign with minutes in T1 and T3.
